purpose: Machine-readable customary corpus that separates the custom itself from geographically scoped attestations, source evidence, negative knowledge, and later Calendar/Place presentation.
invariants: A custom is not a calendar rule, map pin, place, pilgrimage, liturgical rite, or legal obligation merely because those may be related to it.
Geographic claims live in attestations, not in the custom identity itself.
Calendar owns date computation and seasonal triggering; this corpus may carry only non-authoritative trigger hints until an explicit Calendar bridge exists.
Pray owns prayer bodies; Special Days owns ceremonial mechanics; Learn owns explanatory presentation.
A custom may have multiple attestations across time and place without becoming universal.
Geographic proximity to a TLM venue, shrine, community or another custom never proves association.
HOLD and REJECT findings are retained as negative knowledge and may not be published as active customs.
Map-visible claims require geographically specific direct evidence; bibliographic-only or project-evidence sources cannot independently authorize a map claim.
PLACE_PENDING preserves a source-backed named place before the shared Place corpus has assigned a canonical place_id.
Source confidence and customary classification must remain distinct: a strongly sourced local custom is still local.
Current law, 1962 discipline, historical practice and devotional custom must never be collapsed into one status.

releaseGates.customIdentity: Every active custom requires its stable SOT-07 custom_id, canonical statement, class, decision lineage and at least one attestation.
releaseGates.attestationGeography: Every attestation requires a shared geo_area_id, a shared place_id, or both. PLACE_PENDING additionally requires a place_name_hint.
releaseGates.provenance: Every attestation requires source_ids that resolve in the Customs Atlas source registry.
releaseGates.mapSafety: PLACE and ROUTE map policies require a canonical shared place/route reference and direct geographically specific evidence.
releaseGates.pendingPlaceSafety: PLACE_PENDING may surface as an unresolved research/place candidate but must not render as a canonical map point.
releaseGates.negativeKnowledge: HOLD/REJECT rows may not occur in the active customs array.
releaseGates.ownership: Calendar trigger hints are descriptive only and may not drive date logic directly.
releaseGates.associationSafety: No Directory/community association may be created without a separate explicit evidence-backed bridge.
